etsy.title: Movement Break Poster, Brain Break Classroom Sign, Stand and Stretch Reminder, ADHD Friendly Wall Art
etsy.description:
A simple movement break poster inviting stretching, standing, or pacing.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a classroom brain-break corner, sensory room, or ADHD-friendly home.

This listing is a physical poster print, not a substitute for professional medical, therapy, or educational advice. Thank you for supporting a small, neurodivergent-run shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy movement-break results are exercise charts and card sets (16 moves, animal cards); a single calm 'movement is welcome' sign is rare.
Most shared-project results (sensory room, calm corner, neurodiversity decor) are digital printables; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Amazon brain-break posters come as 4-6 poster sets, often 11x17 cardstock, aimed at preschool to elementary, sensory paths and indoor recess.

research.notes: 'movement break' is an Etsy /market phrase; poster added as the product type. Title rewritten to avoid repeating 'break' 3 times. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment (WebFetch blocked); evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with physical signs and did not separate physical poster prices.
